Various major social media sites, such as Youtube, Twitter, Facebook, and search engines like Google, Yahoo are to be unblocked over the course of the year, giving citizens a wider access to useful tools to communicate and to learn from. Eventually, all sites will be allowed for all citizens, except pornographic sites from the current list of banned sites and those that may spring up in the future.

The Chinese Government believes this move will help their citizens out greatly, and will benefit the nation as a whole in the long run.
